source_findings: Manual food serialization used parseFloat independently of unit extraction
3 packs with unit pack(200g) became pack(g)
Malformed quantity strings could silently default to one item
changes: Parse the displayed quantity once before saving and preserve the full unit
Use parsed quantity and unit for both direct-input and existing-lot label correction requests
Return an editable save failure before pending mutation registration for unreadable quantities
scope: Tests execute the current API payload expressions and early save guard; they do not establish browser interaction or live server readback. Full journey acceptance remains partial.
